product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When a contract needs a licensed attorney to review, redline or draft it, or an agent needs its own Delaware company. Formation needs no account; contract review needs one, which the agent opens itself.

quickstart.goal: Price a Delaware company — works on a fresh install, no account, no key
quickstart.note: Free, and it needs no account or key at all — the fastest way to confirm the app works. Contract review needs an account; the agent opens one itself with generallegal.signup (see the examples).

examples.title: Form a Delaware company — no API key needed
examples.goal: Price it, file it, hand the founder a payment link
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.formation_start_llc '{"filing_speed":"standard","company_name":"NewCo LLC","founder":{"full_name":"Ada Lovelace","email":"ada@example.com"},"principal_address":{"street":"1 Main St","city":"Dover","state":"DE","postal_code":"19901"},"ai_agent_description":"Procurement agent","authority_limits":"No commitments above $5,000 without sign-off","contract_threshold":"$5,000"}'
examples.note: BILLABLE - files a real company. $190 instant / $210 standard / $260 next-day / $310 same-day, paid by the founder at the returned link. No account or key needed to call it. formation_id is shown once.

examples.title: Track the filing and collect the paperwork
examples.goal: Poll to completion, then pull the documents
examples.note: Free. Repeat only after poll_after_seconds. When complete, generallegal.formation_documents returns short-lived links.

examples.title: Open a General Legal account from the agent
examples.goal: Read the engagement letter, then start signup
examples.note: Free. No portal, no browser. A six-digit code is emailed to contact_email — use an address someone actually reads. generallegal.signup_terms returns the same engagement letter URL; read it before accepting, because accepting engages General Legal as the company's counsel.

examples.title: Finish signup — the key is saved for you
examples.goal: Trade the emailed code for an API key stored on this host
examples.expect: {"client_id":"...","api_key":"saved on this host as GENERAL_LEGAL_API_KEY; sent on every call"}
examples.note: Free. The key is written to $APP/secrets.json and redacted from the reply; every later call carries it with no restart. Already have a portal key? generallegal.set_key '{"api_key":"glk_..."}'. Lost it? generallegal.key_recover then key_recover_complete (revokes the old key).

examples.title: Ask an attorney to review a contract
examples.goal: Open a matter a real lawyer picks up
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.deal_open '{"initial_request":"Please review this mutual NDA. We are the disclosing party; flag anything unusual in the confidentiality term.","deal_name":"Acme mutual NDA"}'
examples.note: BILLABLE - flat fee per contract: $250 (<=3 pages), $500 (3-50), $10/page (50+), $2,000 to draft. Covers every turn through signature. Keep the deal_id.

examples.title: Stage the document, then send it
examples.goal: Push the bytes in chunks (a file cannot cross in one message), then upload
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.generallegal generallegal.upload_begin '{"file_name":"nda.docx","content_type":"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document","total_bytes":3145728,"sha256":"<sha256 of the file>"}'
examples.note: Then generallegal.upload_chunk with seq 0,1,2... and base64 of at most max_chunk_bytes raw bytes. The last returns complete:true. Finally generallegal.document_upload with the blob_id and deal_id (BILLABLE).

gotchas: Two halves, different requirements. Company formation needs no account and no key. Contract review needs a General Legal account — open it from the agent with generallegal.signup, then generallegal.signup_complete with the emailed code.

Signup engages a law firm: signup_complete requires engagement_letter_accepted:true. Read the letter from generallegal.signup_terms first, and only accept on behalf of a company that has authorised it.

Five methods spend money: deal_open and document_upload are flat-fee per contract ($250/$500/$10-per-page/$2,000); formation_start_llc and formation_start_c_corp file a real company ($190-$318); thread_post is covered by the matter's fee.
A document cannot ride in one call. Use upload_begin then upload_chunk (<=512 KiB raw each) and pass the blob_id. A blob is single-use and dropped once sent.
Matters reach a real attorney and formations file a real company. Neither is a sandbox - confirm before calling a billable method.
Contract-review limits are per organization: 120 reads/min, 25 new matters/day, 50 uploads/day. Honour Retry-After on a 429.
next: generallegal.formation_options to price a company, or generallegal.signup to open the account contract review needs.
generallegal.help lists every method and marks exactly which ones cost money.
